definitions.explanation: Having a relaxed, unhurried attitude without worry or anxiety. Can be positive (carefree) or slightly negative (careless, oblivious to problems).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{呑気|のんき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{笑|わら}っている→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He has an easygoing personality and is always smiling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締切|しめきり}→締切：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦のに→のに：noentry⟧、{呑気|のんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The deadline is near; this is no time to be carefree and playing around.

examples.japanese: {呑気|のんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}えていたら→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧、⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: Because I was too laid-back about it, I missed my chance.

notes:
{呑気|のんき} can have both positive and negative connotations depending on context:
- Positive: relaxed, not stressed, easygoing
- Negative: careless, oblivious, not taking things seriously enough

Alternate kanji spellings:
- {暢気|のんき}
- {呑気|のんき}

Related expressions:
- {呑気|のんき}な{人|ひと} (easygoing person)
- {呑気|のんき}に{構|かま}える (to be laid-back about something)

Similar words:
- のんびり (leisurely, relaxed - adverb/adjective)
- {楽観的|らっかんてき} (optimistic)
